Two plan gaps to fix, two execution notes to incorporate.

(1) Cycle sub-step transient/quota parks (material, P1+P5): the plan scopes transient-failure handling to plain agent steps. Extend it explicitly to adversarial_cycle sub-steps: a FailureInfo kind=transient_* raised from a cycle sub-agent invocation (reviewer/triager/fixer/confirmer, including schema-retry re-invocations in _run_sub) must produce a usage_limit park of the cycle step — not a terminal cycle failure requiring resume --response. Persist sub-agent session ids so plain resume composes with P5 checkpointing: re-enter at the first incomplete sub-step and continue that sub-agent's session per FR-3.3 where the adapter supports it. Add unit tests: quota envelope from a reviewer sub-step mid-round -> cycle parks usage_limit with checkpoints intact; plain resume re-enters at the incomplete sub-step without re-running completed ones. This matches PRD G1 ('loses zero completed sub-steps') and the observed real failure (a cycle killed by a CLI quota error).

(2) Resolve the FR-1.1 vs Q3 tension in P6 (decision, one sentence): P6 SHIPS the standard.yaml flip to prd.md:reference / plan.md:phase per FR-1.1 as the plan says; Q3's 'next real run' guardrail comparison is the first real run after this PRD lands, and a guardrail miss there reverts the flip via a config-only change. State this in P6 explicitly so the P6 builder does not halt on an UPSTREAM CONFLICT between FR-1.1 and the Q3 resolution.

(3) Execution note for P1: harvest the captured error-envelope fixtures from existing failed-run transcripts (runs/*/run-*/steps/*/events.jsonl from the 2026-06-29..07-01 quota halts) rather than waiting to hit a live usage limit.

(4) Execution note for P10: add a one-shot backfill of ~/.gauntlet/usage-ledger.jsonl from existing run manifests so the median estimator has history from the first enforced run.

Infrastructure failure only: the triage step crashed on a missing OPENAI_API_KEY in the invoking shell; no decision change. One item only, from confirm F-003 (unresolved): P10 must include the one-shot backfill of ~/.gauntlet/usage-ledger.jsonl from existing run manifests as a deliverable with a unit test (backfill from two fixture manifests yields correct sliding-window sums; re-running the backfill is idempotent). This was required by prior responses (item 4) but was triage-declined as 'already required' and therefore never added — the decline reasoning was mistaken; add it to P10 now. All other findings and prior notes are correctly incorporated; change nothing else.
